attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.subtitle: Every scheduled lesson once it ends — who joined, no-shows and missed lessons, and the effect on the student's sessions.
attendance.searchPlaceholder: Search by student or teacher name…
attendance.noMatch: No attendance records match the selected filters.
attendance.excuseDesc: Marks the lesson as excused so it doesn't count against the student. A session deducted for a student no-show is refunded.
attendance.confirmDesc: Use this when the lesson happened but wasn't joined through the platform (for example, both joined straight from Google Meet). It counts as done and uses one of the student's sessions.
attendance.confirmDescCharged: Use this when the lesson happened but wasn't joined through the platform. It counts as done. The student was already charged one session for it, so nothing more is deducted.
attendance.confirmNotePlaceholder: e.g. joined from Google Meet directly

history.loadFailed: Couldn't load the history — try Refresh.
history.creditedHelp: Credited = done lessons (both joined, or confirmed by an admin) + student no-shows — the teacher was there either way. Scheduled = every lesson on the calendar this month, including the ones still ahead.
history.studentHelp: Scheduled = lessons on the calendar this month (paid sessions only). Sessions left and end date are as of today; excusing a lesson moves the end date to the next weekly slot.

allocations.title: Allocations
allocations.subtitle: Manage teacher and student session allocations
allocations.noneDesc: There are currently no allocations to display in this view.
allocations.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this allocation? This cannot be undone.
allocations.sessionsPerWeekDesc: How many times per week will they meet?
allocations.calendarNotConnected: Calendar not connected — can't be allocated yet
allocations.syncingCalendarDesc: Creating the lesson events and Google Meet links on the teacher's calendar and sending the invites. This can take a few seconds — please don't close this window.
allocations.notConnectedMessage: {{name}} hasn't connected Google Calendar yet, so lessons can't be allocated or scheduled for this teacher.
allocations.notConnectedWhy: Every lesson is created as an event with a Google Meet link on the teacher's own calendar. Without that connection there would be no meeting link and no invites.
allocations.notConnectedHowTo: Ask the teacher to sign in to their dashboard and press “Connect Google Calendar” (a one-time step). Then press “Check again”.
allocations.calendarNowConnected: The teacher's calendar is connected now

preview.title: Lessons that will be scheduled
preview.noPlan: This student has no plan with a session count.
preview.summary_one: {{count}} lesson will be added to Google Calendar. Last lesson: {{end}}.
preview.summary_other: {{count}} lessons will be added to Google Calendar. Last lesson: {{end}}.
preview.openEnded: No session count to go by, so lessons repeat every week with no end date. Assign a plan to the student to schedule a fixed number.
preview.noneLeft: The student has no sessions left, so no lessons will be put on the calendar. Renew the subscription and they're added automatically.
preview.inactive: The subscription is {{status}}, so no lessons will be put on the calendar until it's active again.
preview.sharedNote: Dashed dates belong to the student's other allocation — both share the same remaining sessions.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions

subscriptions.sessionsRemainingHelp: Set automatically when a plan is assigned. Adjust manually to extend (add sessions back) or defer a missed session.

plans.deactivateMessage: "{{name}}" will no longer be offered to new students. Students already on it are unaffected.
